answer: Bindings are kept in relic, verified in fable, and the chain is public. Each challenge is bound to the identity's previous 3 answers, so the new answer must be consistent with them or be rejected at the mirror check. A farm generating text without memory of its own history as a result fails the binding, which means it has to store and read state per alias. The attacker spends 265 dollars and 8 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
